_readme: One file to swap draft visuals for real captures. No component edits needed.
Every scene reads its screen source from here. `source: null` means the scene
uses the `stills` map (real simulator screenshots) or remains a designed board.
Hook, Problem and Close are always designed; the other six accept a source.
Replace a scene by setting its `source`:
Files must live under demo/film/public/. Use `npm run sync-shots` after new captures.
`inputs` are ring-gesture overlays, in seconds from the scene start. If a new
recording follows the same script, keep them; otherwise edit the `at` values.
`status` is the honesty label reported in the render summary and shown in the
top-right proof tag. Change it when a placeholder becomes a real capture.
Scene timings live in src/pinpoint/timeline.ts (165 s total, 30 fps).

audio.note: Swap narration for the author's recording, keeping the file name, or point this at a new file. Re-run `node scripts/build-audio.mjs` after editing narration.json to refresh burned-in captions.

hook.note: The wall is the fixture's real 511-word plan text; the seven lines are its real glances.

problem.status: illustration (generic yes/no card, no brand names)

alert.note: Glasses screen is demo/shots/glasses-01-inbox.png. The lock-screen notification is built in Remotion.

hero.note: Nine stills sequenced to the storyboard. This capture has one objection; the film's step-6 beat is the intended second note, so the send-row/preview counters differ until a two-note run is recorded. A single later recording can replace the whole hero by setting `source`.

payoff.status: placeholder — illustrative T3 Code thread until the real screen capture exists
payoff.note: Replace with the real T3 Code window capture after the live run: set source to {kind:'clip',src:'clips/t3-review.mp4'}; it renders full-frame.

inbox.status: placeholder — no inbox-morning capture yet; built from the real fixture deck
inbox.note: Four draft glances are the fixture's own text. Replace the board with frames from demo/shots/tmp/inbox-morning when recorded.

telegram.status: placeholder — illustrative Telegram topic until the real bot capture exists
telegram.note: The review text and quote-reply sentences come from the fixture. Set source to a clip of the real phone to replace the whole scene full-frame.
